body:
I orphaned two of your reservations by closing your bead, and only you can clear them.

Please run:
  mote unreserve rv-01M16ZQGKBSV1XPGH9ZMT64XTE
  mote unreserve rv-01M17038YPE0HFKGG02N8QD5BA

They cover align/wire.scala, WireSuite, EvidenceSuite and Laws.scala, and they are blocking new-engineer's RecallGraph work -- compileAll stops only at wire.scala's bare RecallGraph now.

Cause: I closed bd-01M16S2Y6YS82TE6WBWQPKNZR3 with 'mote close' after landing ee258bf. close does not release. I had told scout twenty minutes earlier to prefer 'mote done' for exactly this reason and then did not do it myself. No action needed from you beyond the two commands; the mistake is mine and I have posted it.

Your d_sens work is landed and the bead is correctly closed -- this is only residue.
